notes: REF-BM-02: resolver.js (resolver.js:36-47) collects only title+description from the proxied HTML; no favicon or preview image is ever fetched or stored. REF-BM-03: no edit step exists before the save commits (app.js save() immediately calls store.addFromUrl then resolves metadata in background); editing after save works. REF-BM-04: editRow (app.js:195-276) exposes title/summary/note/labels fields but has no url field, so url cannot be edited. REF-BM-07: list item 'favicon' is a hardcoded emoji lookup by hostname (app.js EMOJI map, emojiFor), not a real favicon, since none is ever collected. REF-BM-12: haystack() (search.js:18-23) indexes title/summary/host/note but not the full url (path/query), so full-text search over 'url' is incomplete. REF-BM-14: haystack() does not include labels/tags at all, and tokenize() has no '#'-prefix handling, so #tag search syntax is unimplemented. REF-BM-15: tokenize() (search.js:6-15) only splits on whitespace and quoted phrases; there is no AND/OR/NOT/parenthesis grammar anywhere in search.js or app.js. REF-BM-20/21: no multi-select checkboxes or bulk-action code exist in app.js or store.js — only per-item actions. REF-BM-23: note field is stored and displayed (app.js noteBlock) but rendered via hiHtml, which only escapes/highlights text — no markdown parsing (bold/links/lists) is applied. REF-BM-24/25: resolver.js explicitly discards fetched HTML after metadata extraction; no snapshot storage (HTML or PDF) or Internet Archive integration exists anywhere. REF-BM-29: no bundle entity or saved-filter feature exists in the codebase. REF-BM-32: sortMode is a transient in-memory UI variable (app.js line 31), never persisted; there is no 'displayed items' or font-size setting anywhere — only the sort dropdown and the sticky to-read checkbox preference (store.js setSavePref) exist.
